name: Approvals
description: Approval inbox: a human-in-the-loop queue where agent-proposed actions, edits, and fixes wait for your accept or reject before they take effect.

permission_levels.label: Can view
permission_levels.description: Read the approval inbox and see what an agent is waiting to do, without accepting or rejecting anything.

permission_levels.label: Can decide
permission_levels.description: Accept or reject queued items, which is what lets an agent's proposed action, edit, or fix actually take effect.
